items.exampleEn: Our team is in the lead now.
Please follow me to your table.
The children created a beautiful picture together.
items.exampleZh: 孩子們一起創作了一幅漂亮的畫。

items.exampleEn: My parents allow me to stay out until ten.
items.exampleZh: 我爸媽允許我在外面待到十點。

items.exampleEn: She offered me a cup of tea.

items.sentenceEn: Do you understand what I mean?

items.audioEn: The ticket includes lunch, but drinks are not included.
items.audioZh: 這張票包含午餐，但不包含飲料。

items.sentenceZh: 我們吃完午餐再繼續吧。

items.sentenceEn: Follow the signs to the station.
items.sentenceZh: 跟著指標走就能到車站。

items.stemEn: Dogs are not ____ in this park.
He ____ to help me with my bags.
items.stemZh: 他主動說要幫我拿行李。

items.passageEn: Last Saturday, my older sister's basketball team played a big game. The other team was in the lead for most of the game. My sister didn't understand why her team was playing so badly. Then the coach offered some advice: "Follow the plan and pass the ball more." The team kept trying, created more chances, and in the end they won!
items.passageZh: 上週六，我姊姊的籃球隊打了一場重要的比賽。整場比賽大部分時間都是對方領先。姊姊不懂為什麼她們隊打得這麼差。後來教練給了一些建議：「照計畫打，多傳球。」她們繼續努力，創造出更多機會，最後贏了！

questions.questionZh: 比賽大部分時間是哪一隊領先？

referenceEn: Pets are not allowed in this hotel.
rubricZh: 可用被動 are not allowed，也可用主動 doesn't allow
「寵物」泛指時用複數（例如 pets）

items.promptZh: 我們的團隊包括三位老師。
rubricZh: 用 include 表示「包括」，主詞是單數所以動詞加 s（例如 includes）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 第②關：疑似：lead 以名詞片語 in the lead「領先（地位）」當本課詞義，A2 學習者最常用的是動詞「帶領；引導」（lead the way、lead a team）；請依 CEFR-J 該級詞性核對，若 A2 是動詞，例句與釋義應改示範動詞用法（閱讀短文同用 in the lead）。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 不改：CEFR-J A2 的 lead 是名詞（動詞為 B1），依執行長「詞義以 CEFR-J 該級詞性＋單元主題常用義為準」照課綱教名詞「領先」
